title: Graded image-filtration comparison and bottom spectral-object factorization
statement: Let $C$ be an abelian category, $Y$ an $\operatorname{EInt}$-indexed first-quadrant abelian spectral object, and $E$ its standard $E_2$ spectral sequence on nonnegative bidegrees [def-sp-spectral-sequence]. Let $H:\mathbb N\to C$ and $h_n:Y.H^n(\bot,\top)\simeq H_n$ be specified isomorphisms. Let $T_n$ be decreasing filtrations [def-sp-filtration] with $T_n^i$ exactly the image, transported by $h_n$, of $Y.H^n(\bot,n+1-i)\to Y.H^n(\bot,\top)$. Let $t_{p,r}:E_r^{p,0}\to E_{r+1}^{p,0}$ for $r\ge2$ satisfy $i_{\rm cycles}t_{p,r}=\pi_{\rm homology}\,\mathrm{iso}_r$. Let $b_{p,r}:E_2^{p,0}\to E_r^{p,0}$ satisfy $b_{p,2}=1$ and $b_{p,r+1}=b_{p,r}t_{p,r}$. There are isomorphisms $g_{p,q}:\operatorname{gr}^pT_{p+q}\simeq E_\infty^{p,q}$, where $E_\infty^{p,q}=E_{p+q+2}^{p,q}$, and $k_p:E_\infty^{p,0}\simeq T_p^p$, such that the quotient projection $T_p^p\to\operatorname{gr}^pT_p$ followed by $g_{p,0}$ is $k_p^{-1}$. The canonical page-two interval comparison $E_2^{p,0}\to Y.H^p(0,1)$, followed by the spectral-object bottom edge and $h_p$, equals $b_{p,p+2}$ followed by $k_p$ and the inclusion $T_p^p\to H_p$. This theorem only compares graded pieces and the bottom projection of the specified image filtration; it does not construct $Y$, $t$, $b$, or cohomology comparisons.

proof.text: Use nonempty_cokernel_ofLE_imageFiltration_iso and nonempty_pageInfinity_iso for the raw image filtration. Transport its consecutive subobject inclusions through h using underlyingIso and cokernel.mapIso; hT identifies the result with the specified filtration T. This proves graded_comparison for every p,q.

Use the explicit bottomPageMap. Its value at r=2 is the page-two interval comparison followed by bottomEdge, by EIsoH_hom_opcyclesIsoH_inv. At r=p+2 it is monic: page comparison, iota-E, fromOpcycles and the inverse H map are monic, and H^p(bottom,p+1)->H^p(bottom,top) is an isomorphism by first-quadrant vanishing in degrees p-1 and p.

Bottom-row outgoing differentials vanish by the natural-number complex shape, so cycles inclusion is invertible. From ht the transitions t are epi. Integer induction from hb2,hbt proves b is epi. Cancel cycles inclusion in bottomPageMap_compatibility and use ht; integer induction then gives b_(p,r) followed by bottomPageMap_(p,r) equals bottomPageMap_(p,2).

Since b_(p,p+2) is epi and bottomPageMap_(p,p+2) is mono, its mono represents the image of bottomPageMap_(p,2). imageSubobject_bottomEdge identifies this image with imageFiltration(p,1). Transport by h and use hT to construct k with Subobject.isoOfEqMk. The preceding induction gives the bottom factorization.

First-quadrant vanishing and hT give T_p^(p+1)=bottom, so its inclusion into T_p^p is zero and its cokernel projection is invertible. For q=0 define g as the inverse cokernel projection followed by k inverse. For q nonzero use graded_comparison. Cancellation proves the quotient identity, completing the existence assertion.
